meta.title: Economic left–right
meta.question: Do Poles want more state or more market in the economy?
meta.measure: Average position on economic questions, from 0 (left) to 10 (right)
meta.anchor: The average of four issue trends (redistribution, state and market, taxes, welfare), each pooled from the questions that ask about it, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.

items.wording: Large income differences are necessary for Poland's prosperity (agree-disagree)
items.notes: POLPAN 1988, 1993, 1998, 2003, 2013, 2018 (6; not 2008). Label 'income differences are necessary' to 1998, '...necessary to assure prosperity' from 2003, same slot (the ISSP item). 1988 and 1993 subsamples as above; 2013 asked of 79%. It correlates -0.14 to -0.25 with the egalitarian items in 1988-2003 but only -0.05 (2013) and -0.02 (2018), when the battery is dominated by agreement: exclude POLPAN 2013 and 2018 (exclusions.csv).

English label 'decrease inequality' to 1998, 'reduce differences in incomes' from 2003, same battery slot. 2013 repeats it in a short module for part of the sample (UZP1B); the regex leaves that copy out.
